subject: Storica pilot — buyer license window & activation obstacles (AWS marketplace)
messages:
From: Emma Holloway <emma.holloway@storica.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Storica pilot request — short term trial via AWS marketplace

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from procurement at Storica — we're evaluating Redwood for a data-labeling assistant in our ops workflow. Our security team is happy with the SOC evidence you shared; next step is purchase path.

We'd like to run a short 3-month pilot (minimal committed spend) and have the purchase handled as an AWS Marketplace private offer. Two asks: can Redwood surface a short-term private offer (3 months) and confirm pricing for the pilot (expected monthly spend ~$15k)? If possible, please include a simple SOW so we can attach to the PO.

Procurement workflow: our CFO only needs to sign for deals >6 months; anything <=3 months is handled by procurement/ops and moves faster. We prefer the private offer so billing flows through our AWS account.

I've attached a one-page draft SOW (see attachment) and can push this through our eProc system quickly if you provide the PO form we should fill.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Holloway
Senior Procurement Manager, Storica
procurement@storica.com

Attachment: Storica_SOW_draft.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Holloway <emma.holloway@storica.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storica pilot request — short term trial via AWS marketplace

Emma — thanks for the clear note and for sharing the SOW. Good to hear security is green.

Short answers up front: yes, we can create an AWS Marketplace private offer for a 3-month pilot. Two items to flag: 1) pricing cadence — private offers on 3-month terms typically have higher unit prices vs 12-months, and 2) activation speed — Marketplace team requires a completed PO form + buyer email list to enable the private offer.

Suggested next steps:
- I'll attach our standard AWS PO form for you to fill (AWS_PO_Form.pdf).
- If you want better unit economics for the pilot, we can offer a one-time pilot discount on the 3-month term; that will need a short internal approval.
- Can you confirm the exact billing owner (AWS account ID) and who will be the invoice contact?

Looping in Vivek (co-sell/partner AM) and Grace (finance activation) to confirm routing and whether we can pre-approve a price exception to keep the pilot within your $15k/mo target. Vivek — does Redwood have precedent for approving a short-term pilot discount that converts to a 12-month commitment if customer expands? Grace — can you confirm the activation checklist for a private offer so we can move quickly once procurement sends back the PO?

I'll stand by for the filled PO and your confirmation on AWS account/billing contact.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: AWS_PO_Form.pdf
From: Emma Holloway <emma.holloway@storica.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storica pilot request — short term trial via AWS marketplace

Jordan — thanks. A few clarifications from our side:
- Billing owner: storica-prod-aws (Account ID: 824159002134)
- Invoice contact: tim.foster@storica.com (Finance)
- We're happy to sign a 3-month pilot PO, but procurement will only escalate to CFO if the term is >6 months. That said, procurement prefers at least a 6–12 month conversion path for vendor relationships.

One constraint: because this is a vendor we expect to re-evaluate quickly, Legal wants an auto-conversion clause (pilot -> annual) to be opt-in on our side. If Redwood insists on auto-convert, procurement will push back.

We'd like to keep this simple: a 3-month pilot priced at ~$15k/mo with the option to convert to an annual at mutually agreed pricing. If you can offer a one-time onboarding credit or trial discount that helps us stay within the budget, we'll prioritize the PO.

Attached: Storica_SOW_draft.pdf (updated with delivery milestones).

Emma

Attachment: Storica_SOW_draft.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Holloway <emma.holloway@storica.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Storica pilot request — short term trial via AWS marketplace

Team — forwarding Storica request. Key asks: 3-month private offer, target spend ~$15k/mo, account ID 824159002134, invoice contact tim.foster@storica.com. Procurement prefers conversion path but Legal won't accept forced auto-convert.

Questions for internal approval:
- Pricing exception: can we give a 15–20% pilot discount and mark it as one-time onboarding credit (non-recurring) to keep pilot economics acceptable?
- Activation: Grace, what’s the minimum evidence we need to get the marketplace tile and private offer live after we receive their filled PO? Any blockers on our end for same-day activation?

I've attached a quick pricing breakdown with two scenarios (3mo pilot vs 12mo annual) to help show the conversion economics. If we approve a non-recurring onboarding credit, we should also require a follow-up cadence (30/60/90) and a conversion checkpoint.

Attachment: pricing_breakdown.xlsx

Thanks — Jordan
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Storica pilot request — short term trial via AWS marketplace

Jordan / Grace — reviewed. Approve a limited pilot concession: up to 20% one-time onboarding credit on the 3-month private offer, conditioned on a mutual action plan and two conversion checkpoints (after month 1 and month 3). Terms:
- Pilot term: 3 months
- Pilot price: list price less 20% onboarding credit (credit applied in month 1 invoice only)
- Conversion: customer can opt-in to a 12-month commitment within 30 days of pilot end; if they opt-in, we’ll lock in a discounted annual rate (to be negotiated separately) and apply any unused onboarding credit as a one-time account credit (no auto-convert without mutual consent)
- Activation: Grace, please confirm activation SLAs once the completed PO is received (we should be able to spin up the private offer within 48 hours if docs are clean)

Jordan — confirm with Emma we’ll provide the 20% onboarding credit and the mutual action plan. I’ll prepare a short approval PDF and loop Legal for the conversion wording.

Attachment: discount_approval.pdf

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Co-sell Partnerships — Redwood Inference
